domain: cylindrical involute gears (ISO 21771 / ISO 53 / ISO 1328-1) and related gear geometry

conventions.angles: All expression angles are radians. Engine inputs/outputs in degrees are converted by the harness (variable unit 'rad', engine unit 'deg').
conventions.status_policy: Statuses are computed by app.knowledge.validation, never declared here. VERIFIED requires a DAYANERA ISO evidence requirement (app.calc.evidence.REQ) AND numerical agreement of the deterministic engine over the validation matrix. External code never makes a rule VERIFIED on its own.
conventions.external_expressions: Each external observation is a clean-room normalized reading of the cited line (file/symbol/line/commit), written in DAYANERA variables. 'domain' restricts the comparison to where the implementation's convention applies.

beta.description: helix angle at the reference cylinder

d_y.description: any diameter between base and tip circle

s_t.description: transverse tooth thickness at the reference circle

s_n.description: normal tooth thickness at the reference cylinder

s_yt.description: transverse tooth thickness at diameter d_y

z2.description: wheel tooth count; ring gear tooth count for internal pairs

inv_alpha_wt.description: involute of the working transverse pressure angle

inv_alpha_wt_int.description: involute of the working pressure angle of an internal pair

alpha_wt_int.description: working pressure angle of an internal pair

a_w_int.description: working centre distance of an internal pair

r_y.description: radius of the involute point at roll angle phi

phi_twist.description: rotation of the transverse section over the facewidth

i_ring_fixed.description: sun-to-carrier ratio with the ring held fixed

assembly_residue.description: (z_sun + z_ring) mod n_p; 0 means equally spaced planets can be assembled

ring_phase_deg.description: ring rotation used by a CAD generator to phase its teeth

gamma.description: worm lead angle at the reference cylinder

d_minus_root.description: d_b − d_f; > 0 means a non-involute root flank below the base circle

rules.name: Derivative of the involute function used as a Newton step
rules.display: claimed: d(inv α)/dα = 1/cos α − 1   (true: tan² α)

iso.citation: calculus identity check (d/dα (tan α − α) = tan² α)

rules.implementation_notes: Harmless in freecad.gears: the damped Newton iteration still converges because the sign is right, and the root is checked on |f|. DAYANERA does not adopt it: app.knowledge.expr.involute_inverse uses bisection.
